question: Where was the Patrika Gate inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in September 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __Jaipur.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Patrika Gate in Jaipur__ through video conferencing on 8 September 2020.
 
• The iconic gate is built by the Patrika Group of Newspapers on the Jawaharlal Nehru Marg in Jaipur.
 
• On this occasion, the Prime Minister also launched two books - Samvad Upanishad and Akshar Yatra - authored by Editor-in-Chief of Rajasthan Patrika Group Gulab Kothari.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Patrika Gate:

 
 
• It is located in Jaipur at Jawahar Circle.
 
• It was virtually inaugurated by prime minister Narendra Modi.
 
• This was constructed by Jaipur Development Authority under mission Anupam Yojana.
 
• It reflects the architectural style and cultural heritage of the state.
 
• The Patrika gate incorporates the art and culture of all corners of Rajasthan.
